item.title: WATCH: Fishermen rescued after 5 days at sea inside cooler
item.description: The Mexican navy rescued the men after an aircraft spotted them drifting in the Pacific.

item.title: WATCH: USS Lincoln heading home after 272 days at sea
item.description: President Trump has vowed unprecedented "economic warfare" against Iran. The warning comes as the USS Lincoln returns from its record deployment.

item.title: Japan hangs man convicted of killing 5 people at pachinko parlor
item.description: Sunao Takami set fire to a crowded pachinko parlor in Osaka by spreading gasoline and throwing a lit match, engulfing the building and killing five people.

item.title: U.S. designates American citizen held by China as wrongfully detained
item.description: Min Zin is the second American academic to be designated as wrongfully detained in recent months.
